title: JoshiPVP's Pack
body:
This is my Texture Pack. I use it in my Videos and streams. Enjoy!
This Pack changes the Hotbar, Hearts, Hungerbars, Levelbar, Rain and Totem.

**Hotbar:** It's white with a green selector.

**Hearts:** They are normal, but recoloured in green.

**Hungerbars:** They are also recoloured in green.

**Levelbar:** Also.

**Rain:** Also.

**Totem:** It's my Skin.
